title: Generate video with Sora · Level 1
slo: Explain how to create, check, and download a Sora video job.

exercises.question_text: Which are capabilities of Sora 1? Select all that apply.

options.text: Creates short clips from text prompts
options.rationale: Correct. Sora 1 creates short clips from text prompts. This is a core capability.

options.text: Uses images to guide video creation
options.rationale: Correct. Sora 1 can use images as guidance. The image helps shape the clip.
Correct. Sora 1 supports multiple resolutions and durations. These settings shape a clip.

options.text: Remixes an existing video with targeted edits
options.rationale: Targeted video remixing is a Sora 2 capability. It is not listed for Sora 1.
options.better_fit: Use this for Sora 2 edits to an existing video.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Sora 1 supports prompt-based clips, image guidance, and flexible settings.

exercises.question_text: Which Sora model supports video-to-video remixing?

options.rationale: Correct. Sora 2 supports video-to-video remixing. Remix makes targeted changes to an existing video.
Sora 1 creates new short clips. Video-to-video remixing is identified for Sora 2.
options.better_fit: Use Sora 1 for a new short prompt-based clip.

options.error_type: Confuses image editing with video remix
options.rationale: GPT-Image-1 edits still images. It does not make targeted edits to videos.
options.better_fit: Use it to generate or edit a still image.

options.error_type: Confuses visual reasoning with video editing
options.rationale: GPT-4.1-mini can reason about content. It is not a video remix model.
options.better_fit: Use it to analyze an image or answer questions about it.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Sora 2 supports targeted video remixing.

exercises.question_text: Sora 1 can create short video clips from text prompts and can use images as guidance.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A creator could miss an available image-guidance option.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Sora 1 creates short text-based clips and can use image guidance.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Both capabilities are available in Sora 1.

exercises.question_text: Sora 2 supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video remix.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A valid creation or revision path could be overlooked.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Sora 2 supports text, image, and existing-video inputs.

exercises.explanation: Correct. All three creation paths are supported.

exercises.question_text: Which areas are covered by Sora Responsible AI safeguards? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Correct. Restrictions can involve real people. This is a safeguard area.
Correct. Restrictions can involve copyrighted characters. This is a safeguard area.
Correct. Certain content types can be restricted. Safeguards limit inappropriate use.
Dimensions are generation settings. They are not a Responsible AI restriction.
options.better_fit: Use this when selecting a video's output format.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Safeguards include restrictions involving these areas.

exercises.question_text: Which models are native video-generation models in Foundry?

options.rationale: Correct. Sora 1 and Sora 2 are Foundry's native video-generation models. They produce video output.

options.error_type: Confuses image generation with video generation
options.rationale: These are image-generation models. They do not produce video output.
options.better_fit: Use them to create or edit still images.

options.error_type: Confuses multimodal analysis with video generation
options.rationale: These models can reason over inputs such as text and images. They are not native Foundry video-generation models.
options.better_fit: Use them for analysis or responses about supplied content.

options.error_type: Confuses image models with video models
options.rationale: These are still-image generation models. They do not create original video clips.
options.better_fit: Use them for cost-conscious still-image generation.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Sora 1 and Sora 2 create video output.

exercises.question_text: Sora Responsible AI safeguards are mainly controls for selecting video resolution and duration.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Format settings could be mistaken for safety restrictions.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Safeguards restrict harmful, prohibited, or inappropriate use.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Those are generation settings, not safeguards.

exercises.question_text: Any multimodal model that can process images can also generate video output.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The team could select a model that cannot make the requested clip.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Sora 1 and Sora 2 are the native Foundry video-generation models.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Visual understanding does not imply video generation.

options.text: A web interface for programs using HTTP
options.rationale: Correct. A REST API lets programs communicate using HTTP. It is the underlying web interface.

options.text: A toolkit built on a web interface
options.rationale: This defines an SDK. A REST API is the underlying interface.
options.better_fit: Use this definition for an SDK.

options.rationale: This defines curl. Curl is a tool that can call an API.
A REST API is a communication interface. A deployment makes a model available.
options.better_fit: Use this for a Sora deployment.

exercises.explanation: Correct. A REST API is a web interface used through HTTP.

exercises.question_text: Which details belong in the request that creates a Sora video job? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Correct. The creation request includes a model. It identifies the video model to use.
Correct. The creation request includes a prompt. It describes the requested video.
Correct. The creation request includes size and seconds. They specify dimensions and duration.
The MP4 exists after the job completes. Creation returns a video ID instead.
options.better_fit: Use this after polling reports completed.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Creation uses model, prompt, size, and seconds.

exercises.question_text: A developer can use a REST API directly when no SDK exists for the programming language they use.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: An integration option could be overlooked.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: An SDK sits on an interface such as a REST API, which can be used directly.

exercises.explanation: Correct. The underlying REST API can be called directly.

exercises.question_text: After creating a video job, download the MP4 before checking whether the job is completed.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: An app could try to retrieve an unfinished video.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Create the job, poll status, then download only after completion.

flashcards.back: Short video clips from text prompts, with optional image guidance.
Targeted edits to an existing video without regenerating the whole result.
Repeatedly checking a job's status until it completes or fails.
A command-line tool that sends and receives HTTP data.
